subject: English
passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
• The international Fair Trade movement was established in 1967 with the creation of the first Fair Trade organization.
• The movement promotes economic opportunities for disadvantaged producers in developing countries.
• It ensures that farmers and artisans receive fair prices for their goods and work in safe conditions.
• It supports environmentally sustainable farming and production methods that protect local ecosystems.
• Fair Trade USA was founded as an independent organization in 2011.
prompt: The student wants to introduce the Fair Trade movement to a new audience. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

choices.A: The creation of the first Fair Trade organization in 1967 marked the establishment of the international Fair Trade movement, while Fair Trade USA was founded as an independent organization in 2011.
choices.B: The Fair Trade movement supports environmentally sustainable farming and production methods.
choices.C: Goals of the movement include fair prices for producers and environmentally sustainable production methods.
choices.D: The international Fair Trade movement, established in 1967, promotes economic opportunities for disadvantaged producers while ensuring fair prices, safe working conditions, and environmentally sustainable production methods.

explanation:
Choice D is correct. It introduces Fair Trade to a new audience: established in 1967, it promotes economic opportunities while ensuring fair prices and sustainable production.

Why A is incorrect:

Choice A is incorrect. While the sentence indicates when the international Fair Trade movement and Fair Trade USA were founded, it doesn't effectively introduce the movement to a new audience.
